name: staff-role-list-permission-fix
title: Fix employee modal role list authorization
description: Allow staff-management users to load authoritative role options through the effective staff.read permission instead of fixed role slugs.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The selected restaurant reaches StaffManagement and the employee modal. Step-one validation blocks because roleList errors before createStaff is called. The root authorization boundary is the roleList resolver, which still checks fixed role names instead of the effective staff.read permission used by current RBAC flows.
